ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The Body Articulated: The class will research a diverse group of artist and a broad array of contrivances, both historical and contemporary, that extend or mediate our physical presence in the world. We will explore the intimate and transformative relationship that have with the body and how the dream of these contrivances extend & free the body and 'speak' to a larger world/community. The structure of assignments will consist of initial concept staging, research, presentation, and execution. The Body Articulated is not media specific ø an emphasis on the expressive power of materials that are laden with meaning and their ability to enhance the intent of the work will be an integral part of concept formation. Undergraduate Section. $20 Facilities Charge.
